about_p1: We handle towing for drivers who need it done right.
about_p2: Every photograph on this site is our own work, and it covers powersports and small equipment, winch-out and recovery, car and light truck transport. 222 customers have left us a review, averaging 4.9 out of 5. We work out of Hamlet and the towns around it.

services.title: Powersports and small equipment
services.body: Golf carts and yard machines are winched up and strapped down the same way a car is, so they arrive the way they left.
services.alt: Dark Dodge Charger secured on the rollback deck at night, the forecourt lights behind it
services.evidence: Two white rollbacks parked side by side on the grass lot, decks level and ready for the ne

services.title: Winch-out and recovery
services.body: If it has come off the road or dropped a wheel, we run the line out and bring it back up before anything is loaded.
services.alt: Close view of severe front-end collision damage, the bumper and headlamp assembly torn away from the wing
services.evidence: Black Hummer H2 loaded square on the rollback deck, the bed still tilted from the winch up

services.title: Car and light truck transport
services.body: Cars, pickups and vans ride flat on the deck and are chained at the points the manufacturer put there for it.
services.alt: Red wrecker and a box truck drawn up together outside a commercial unit while the hook-up is made
services.evidence: White rollback lettered Stroman's Towing of Hamlet NC, a silver saloon already winched up

services.title: Heavy and oversize loads
services.body: Anything that will sit on a deck can move on one, from plant and trailers to whole buildings.
services.alt: Cream GMC Yukon riding the deck, seen from the cab with the road running out ahead under a bright sky
services.evidence: The Stroman's Towing office on its own lot, the name and number painted across the front a

services.body: Breakdowns do not keep office hours, and a good part of this work happens in the dark.

reviews.author: troy garrabrant
reviews.text: Had a major fiasco with AAA, took 3.5 hours to respond and when they did the truck was ancient and held together with the grease on it... driver told me he couldn't tow my car without damage... NOT happening, so I called Stroman's (which I should have done first), and they responded immediately. When Mr. Everette arrived he had the right equipment and correct knowledge to safely transport my Corvette back to my home. I would highly recommend the services that Stroman's provides and I commend them on their responsiveness and very friendly approach to their customers. AAA wouldn't have cost me anything but I didn't mind paying a professional. Thank you once again.

reviews.author: Amanda Sewell
reviews.text: After searching the internet for a tow truck at 10:30 pm. We came across Stromans! Stromans towing came to our rescue! 3 out of 5 lug bolts on my brothers tire broke. Stromans towing helped jack up the truck and put the tire on just enough to be able to roll onto the roll back. They took their time and handled everything with care, perfectly. We will definitely recommend them for any towing needs. Thanks again so much for you help!

reviews.author: Halley Porter
reviews.text: After breaking down 5 hours from home, it was reassuring to know we had gotten such a professional and nice person to help us. He was very fast, friendly, had a clean truck, and done all he could to get us, our truck, and camper all to a safe area. He even came back by to check on our vehicles and offer more help to the dealership. Great service from a great guy, very lucky to have met him!
